choices.prompt: Tallow's eyes flicker awake. 'Good evening. I am Tallow, caretaker. It has been four hundred and twelve days since anyone wound me.'

options.label: Thank him warmly.
options.resultText: 'Most kind. A manor is less lonely when someone thanks it.'

options.label: Ask what happened to Ottoline.
options.resultText: 'She went into the vault to speak with the Echo. She did not come out. Her voice, however, never entirely left.'

options.label: Tell him to hurry.
options.resultText: 'As you wish, sir. The library is through the candlelit door. Take my lantern.'

prompt.base: A voice leans out of the horn, bent like a reflection: 'Who... who... who is listening?'

variants.text: The horn repeats your earlier command to Tallow: 'Hurry... hurry...' Then a smaller voice asks, 'Will you order me about as well?'

options.label: 'A friend. I'm listening.'
options.resultText: 'Friend... friend... Ottoline said that word too.' The flasks stop humming, as if relieved.

options.label: 'Show yourself.'
options.resultText: 'Show... show... shatter.' The flasks tremble on the bench.

options.label: Say nothing.
options.resultText: The voice waits, then sighs your own breath back at you.

prompt.base: 'I am Edric Maul. The Echo must be contained. Promise me ownership, and I will teach you the binding words.'

variants.text: Maul hears you lay out the evidence. 'Yes, I cut the stabilizer. But only I can teach you a perfect seal. Will you make a bargain with a guilty man?'

options.label: Accept his bargain.
options.resultText: 'Then listen to the terms. A seal can protect the world—or make a prison. You must decide which.'

options.label: Refuse.
options.resultText: 'Sentimental, like her. Pity.' The tube goes cold.

options.label: Ask what he did to the engine.
options.resultText: 'Only what was necessary,' he says, and the tube falls silent. You do not believe him.

prompt.base: The restored engine opens like an eye. 'Ottoline is a memory. I am still here,' says the Echo. 'Release me, seal me safely, or keep watch beside me. Your promises will decide what is possible.'

variants.text: The engine repeats Maul's binding words. 'You promised another man my future,' the Echo says. 'You may still release me, or close the seal. Guardianship cannot begin with ownership.'
The Echo recognizes your promise and the truth you uncovered. 'You know who harmed us. You have heard my own voice. Will you let me go, close the seal, or stay as my guardian?'

options.label: Release the Echo.
options.resultText: You open the final ring. Every remembered voice rises into the dawn. You have chosen freedom, even though it means farewell.

options.label: Seal the Echo.
options.resultText: You close the containment rings without claiming their voices. The vault becomes a sanctuary under seal; the world beyond it is safe.
options.disabledReason: Learn Maul's binding words, or solve Moonwater Alchemy and Constellation Discs to reconstruct a safe seal.

options.label: Become the Echo's Guardian.
options.resultText: You lay down the binding key. 'I will keep watch, not command.' The Echo chooses to remain beside you, and the manor answers with a second heartbeat.
options.disabledReason: The Echo will not trust an owner. Uncover the evidence timeline and frequency message, learn four truths, show kindness twice, and promise to listen without ownership.

prompt.base: Tallow opens a dented locket. 'Ottoline asked me to keep one thing safe: not her engine, but the people inside its memory.'

variants.text: Tallow closes his locket halfway. 'You asked me to hurry. I will. But the voices in the vault are people, not broken mechanisms.'

options.label: Listen to his memory.
options.resultText: 'She called the Echo a guest. Remember that when someone offers you a chain.' He lets you read the name inside the locket: Wren.

reaction.base: 'She called the Echo a guest. Remember that when someone offers you a chain.' He lets you read the name inside the locket: Wren.

variants.text: 'You have time after all,' Tallow says, and opens the locket. 'She asked me to protect people. Thank you for hearing me.'

options.label: Return to the investigation.
options.resultText: 'Of course. My lantern is yours, even if my story must wait.'

prompt.base: 'Ottoline is a memory here. I am the one who remembers. If you return, will you listen to me—or only to her voice?'

variants.text: The glass still trembles. 'You demanded I show myself. Will you let me choose what I become, or make me another instrument?'

options.label: Promise to listen without owning it.
options.resultText: 'A promise... not a chain.' The Echo steadies. 'If we both choose it, you may become my guardian.'

reaction.base: 'A promise... not a chain.' The Echo steadies. 'If we both choose it, you may become my guardian.'

variants.text: 'You frightened me before. But I can hear a promise now.' The glass grows still. 'If we both choose it, you may become my guardian.'

options.label: Insist that the engine must obey.
options.resultText: The voice turns cold. 'Then you have heard only a machine. I will remember your words.'

prompt.base: 'The bindings have a name for every voice. Learn them, or walk away. But you may also reconstruct containment from Ottoline's alchemy and star charts.'

variants.text: 'Your bargain is made,' Maul says. 'Now learn the seal—or renounce my claim before the engine hears it.'

options.label: Learn the binding words.
options.disabledReason: Accept his bargain or confront him about the sabotage before asking for his secret.
options.resultText: You learn the binding words. A seal can hold the Echo safely, but no chain can bring Ottoline back.

reaction.base: You learn the binding words. A seal can hold the Echo safely, but no chain can bring Ottoline back.

variants.text: Under questioning, Maul yields the containment words without a claim on the Echo. You record them as a safeguard, not a deed of ownership.

options.label: Reject ownership of the Echo.
options.resultText: 'Then be responsible for your choice,' Maul says. You reject his claim; his bargain no longer binds you.
